blocks.text: 1958 mein American mahireen-e-hayatiyat Matthew Meselson aur Franklin Stahl ne teen models jaanche aur dikhaya ke DNA replication semi-conservative hai.

items: Bacteria ko nitrogen ke bhaari isotope 15N wale medium par ugaya gaya jo normal 14N ki jagah un ke DNA ke nitrogen bases mein gaya; kai naslon ke baad un ka DNA normal se ziada ghana tha.
Phir bacteria ko 14N wale medium mein muntaqil kiya gaya taa ke naya DNA 14N se bane, aur bacteria ke taqseem hone ke saath waqfon se DNA jama kiya gaya.

DNA ko caesium chloride ke mehlool mein ghol kar ultracentrifuge kiya gaya; is se density ka gradient banta hai, neeche sab se ghana, aur har qisam ka DNA wahan thehrta hai jahan us ki density mehlool se mile. Ghana 15N DNA halke 14N DNA se neeche thehrta hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: 15N wale medium (gulabi flask) mein uge bacteria 14N wale medium (neela flask) mein muntaqil hote hain. Baen taraf 14N flasks: koi replication nahi, aik round aur do rounds. Har namoone ka DNA CsCl mehlool (solution) mein ultracentrifuge hota hai. Tubes: aik bhaari patti; aik darmiyani patti; aik halki aur aik darmiyani patti. Saath DNA molecules (surkh 15N, neele 14N strands) aur Light-Heavy paimane par DNA pattiyon ki tasveerein.

blocks.long_description: Patti labels: 15N-15N All DNA heavy; 15N-14N All DNA intermediate density; 50% 15N-14N DNA intermediate density, 50% 14N-14N DNA light density.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har patti DNA ki kasafat (density) batati hai: bhaari 15N-15N tah ke qareeb, halka 14N-14N oopar, aur hybrid 15N-14N beech mein. Aik round ke baad sirf darmiyani patti aur do rounds ke baad aadhi darmiyani aur aadhi halki: yahi semi-conservative replication hai.

aik darmiyani aur aik halki patti
har hybrid aik bhaari strand naye hybrid ko aur aik halka strand bilkul 14N molecule ko deta hai

blocks.title: Nasl mein radio-isotope nishan wale DNA ka peecha
blocks.text: Aisa tajarba jis mein radio-isotope nishan wale DNA ka jandar ki nasl mein peecha kiya jaye pulse-chase experiment kehlata hai. Pulse marhale mein jandar thori der radio-isotope ke saamne rehta aur ise apne DNA mein shamil karta hai; chase marhale mein nishan wale DNA ko waqt ke saath us ki radioactivity naap kar dekha jata hai.

blocks.prompt: 20 minute par aik darmiyani patti conservative model ko kyun radd karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Conservative model aik replication ke baad aik bhaari (sirf 15N) aur aik halki (sirf 14N) patti deta, aik hybrid patti nahi.

items: 15N mein uge bacteria 14N mein; DNA caesium chloride mein ghumaya.
0 min bhaari; 20 min hybrid; 40 min hybrid + halka.
Nateeja sirf semi-conservative model se milta hai.
